name: KeyStone Co-Pack Manufacturing, LLC
old_description: KeyStone CoPack is your trusted partner for premium supplement manufacturing. From R&D to blending, filling, and packaging, we provide full turnkey services to bring your product to market with quality and efficiency.
about:
KeyStone Co-Pack Manufacturing operates from Pleasant Grove, Utah. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides turnkey contract manufacturing for nutritional supplements and personal care products. Services span ideation, formulation development, ingredient sourcing, production, packaging, and delivery. Production capabilities include powder blending and filling, capsule and tablet manufacturing, and gusseted bag filling. Packaging formats range from sticks, sachets, and tubs to bottles, jars, and vials. The company maintains a large inventory of hundreds of ingredients and employs R&D scientists to develop custom formulations. Fulfillment is coordinated through nearby partners.

KeyStone serves the food and beverage, health and wellness, and personal care and beauty sectors. Food and beverage clients include brands producing protein powders, baking mixes, and unpasteurized beverage shots. Health and wellness customers request protein blends, electrolytes, pre-workouts, and performance-enhancing powdered supplements. Personal care and beauty projects cover hair care, skincare, and oral care products.

The company emphasizes a full-service model that combines cost efficiency, a broad supplier network, regulatory knowledge, and specialized expertise to bring products to market quickly. It positions itself as a partner that handles every step from concept to delivery, allowing brands to focus on growth.
